name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; winter margin 9.5%
summary: NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW, 9.5% winter buffer; no Electricity Margin or Gas Margins Notice in force as of 14 Nov
state: NESO's Winter Outlook of 23 Oct forecasts a 5.9 GW surplus, a 9.5% buffer over peak demand, within the reliability standard, and says routine Electricity Margin Notices do not indicate a risk to supplies (NESO). NESO issued precautionary notices on low-wind days in October, which lapsed (OilPrice.com). Searches on 14 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Electricity and gas supplies in Great Britain are expected to meet demand this winter. Occasional precautionary notices on cold, still days are routine and do not mean power cuts.
rubric_hit: Normal: NESO reports adequate margins (9.5% buffer); no notice in force
basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices
basis_by: NESO and National Gas system notices

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability
OilPrice.com — Low wind generation prompts another power margin warning in UK

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
